earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 earningsrelease3q26ex-991.htm EX-99.1 EarningsRelease 3Q26 (EX-99.1) 1 Exhibit 99.1 NEW YORK, October 22, 2026 - Nasdaq, Inc. (Nasdaq: NDAQ) today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026 . Adena Friedman, Chair and CEO said, “Nasdaq’s third quarter performance demonstrates the strength and momentum of our business, with new milestones achieved across all three divisions, including record Index net inflows, record FinTech ARR growth, and the establishment of Nasdaq Digital Liquidity Networks within Market Services. Markets are evolving towards an AI- driven, Always-On future that is increasingly integrated across asset classes and geographies. Nasdaq is shaping the next generation of market infrastructure while expanding our growth opportunities and enhancing the value we deliver to our clients and shareholders.” • Third quarter 2026 net revenue 1 was $ 1.5 billion , an increase of 13% over the third quarter of 2025 , or 14% on an organic 2 basis. Solutions revenue 3 increased 17% , or 18% on an organic basis. • Annualized Recurring Revenue (ARR) 3,4 of $ 3.4 billion increased 12% on a reported basis over the third quarter of 2025 , or 14% on an organic basis. Annualized SaaS revenue increased 12% , or 16% on an organic basis, and represented 38% of ARR. • Financial Technology revenue was $ 529 million, an increase of 16% on both a reported and organic basis over the third quarter of 2025 . • Index revenue of $286 million grew 39% on both a reported and organic basis over the third quarter of 2025 , with $141 billion of net inflows over the trailing twelve months, including $49 billion in the third quarter of 2026 . • GAAP diluted earnings per share in the third quarter of 2026 was $0.96 , an increase of 31% over the third quarter of 2025 . Non-GAAP 5 diluted earnings per share in the third quarter of 2026 was $1.04 , an increase of 18% on a reported basis over the third quarter of 2025 , or 19% on an organic basis. • In the third quarter of 2026 , the company returned $ 173 million to shareholders through dividends and $ 323 million through repurchases of common stock. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Sarah Youngwood, Executive Vice President and CFO said, “Nasdaq delivered excellent third quarter results, headlined by outstanding Solutions revenue growth, continued operating leverage, and strong EPS growth. Our durable business model and disciplined execution underpin our capital allocation strategy that prioritizes funding investments in long-term growth while returning more than $1.7 billion to shareholders year to date through share repurchases and dividends.” (US$ millions, except per share) 3Q26 YoY change % Organic 2 YoY change % Adjusted 2 YoY change % Solutions revenue $ 1,172 17% 18% 18% Market Services net revenue $ 309 2% 2% 2% Net revenue $1,481 13% 14% 14% GAAP operating income $732 25% Non-GAAP operating income $843 15% 16% 16% ARR $ 3,365 12% 14% 14% GAAP diluted EPS $0.96 31% Non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.04 18% 19% 19% 2 FINANCIAL REVIEW • Third quarter 2026 net revenue was $ 1.5 billion, reflecting 13% growth on a reported basis versus the prior year period, or 14% growth on an organic basis. • Solutions revenue was $ 1.2 billion in the third quarter of 2026 , an increase of 17% versus the prior year period, or 18% on an organic basis. Performance in the quarter reflected strong growth across Capital Access Platforms and Financial Technology. Capital Access Platforms revenue growth was 20% year-over-year on both a reported and organic basis. Financial Technology revenue growth was 16% , on both a reported and organic basis. • ARR was $ 3.4 billion as of the third quarter of 2026 , growing 12% year-over-year on a reported basis, or 14% on an organic basis. The difference between total reported and organic ARR growth results from the impact of divestitures, which were excluded from ARR in the prior year period. Financial Technology ARR growth was 18% on both a reported and organic basis, and Capital Access Platforms ARR growth was 8% on both a reported and organic basis. • Market Services net revenue was $309 million in the third quarter of 2026 , up 2% on both a reported and organic basis versus the prior year period. • Third quarter 2026 GAAP operating expenses were $ 749 million, an increase of 3% versus the prior year quarter. Non-GAAP operating expenses were $638 million, up 9% versus the prior year quarter, or 12% on an organic basis. The increases were primarily driven by higher compensation and benefits costs from our strong revenue execution and increased investments in technology to drive long-term growth . On a GAAP basis, the increase was partially offset by lower general and administrative expenses, primarily due to a favorable legal settlement , and lower restructuring charges. • Cash flow from operations was $ 521 million in the third quarter, enabling the return of capital through Nasdaq’s efficient capital allocation framework. In the third quarter of 2026 , the company returned $ 173 million to shareholders through dividends and $ 323 million through repurchases of common stock. As of September 30, 2026 , there was $ 2.2 billion remaining under the board authorized share repurchase program. 2026 EXPENSE AND TAX GUIDANCE UPDATE 6 • The company is updating its 2026 non-GAAP operating expense guidance to a range of $2.550 billion to $2.580 billion . The company is maintaining its 2026 non-GAAP tax rate guidance in the range of 22.5% to 24.5% . 3 STRATEGIC AND BUSINESS UPDATES • F inancial Te chnology delivered record 18% organic ARR growth and double-digit revenue growth in each subdivision for the third consecutive quarter. FinTech signed 54 new clients and 135 upsells in the quarter with cloud-based solutions accounting for 85% of ACV bookings . FinTech performance reflected continued execution on the One Nasdaq strategy with 5 cross-sells signed in the quarter and cross-sells accounting for over 15% of the sales pipeline. Nasdaq achieved a second-place ranking on the Chartis RiskTech100, up from fifth place in the prior year. ◦ Financial Crime Management Technology revenue and ARR growth accelerated with momentum across SMBs and enterprise clients. Nasdaq Verafin signed 45 new small-and-medium bank (SMB) clients and 3 enterprise deal s in the third quarter, bringing year-to-date enterprise signings to 12, surpassing the 9 enterprise deals signed in all of 2025. Nasdaq Verafin announced the general availability of two new AI workers, the Agentic AML Analyst and the Agentic Fraud Analyst, and now has more than 850 clients using its Agentic AI Workforce. ◦ Regulatory Technology achieved the f ifth straight quarter of accelerating ARR growth led by strong performance across Surveillance and AxiomSL. The subdivision added 10 new clients , including 2 cross-sells, and 86 upsells in the third quarter, driven by demand for cloud infrastructure, AI, digital assets, and regulatory requirements. Surveillance signe d 9 n ew clients, including 2 cross-sells and strategic wins with Kalshi and Kraken, while also achieving 51 upsells. AxiomSL added 1 new client and 35 upsells in the third quarter, including an expansion with a Global Systemically Important Bank (G-SIB) for a Basel III implementation. ◦ Capital Mark e ts Technology delivered robust organic ARR growth with broad- based strength across the subdivision. The subdivision signed 2 new clients, including 1 cross-sell, and 48 upsells in the third quarter. Calypso added 2 new clients, including 1 cross-sell, and 23 upsells. Nasdaq partnered with HSBC to co-develop comprehensive exchange-traded derivatives (ETD) clearing capabilities in Calypso, creating a unified platform HSBC has selected for clearing across OTC, ETD, and repos. Nasdaq also launched a new operating environment which enables clients to connect their own AI infrastructure and serve as an access point for Calypso’s agentic capabilities. Market Technology signed 25 upsells in the quarter and continued to shape Always-On markets, signing a deal with Bruce Market s to power the first 24/7 continuous trading in U.S. equities. • Index set new ETP assets under management (AUM) and net inflow records while executing on its growth pillars of product innovation, international expansion, and institutional adoption. Index had a record $ 141 billion in net inflows over the trailing twelve months, including $ 49 billion in the third quarter. End-of-period ETP AUM was $ 1.160 trillion and average ETP AUM over the third quarter was $ 1.108 trillion, both new records. Nasdaq launched 32 new Index products in the third quarter, including 10 in the institutional annuity space. Half of the new products launched in the third quarter were outside the U.S. 4 • Nasdaq extended its listings leadership with 8 of the 10 largest operating company IPOs in the third quarter. Nasdaq welcomed 15 new operating companies that raised $32 billion in capital 7 , reflecting a 79% win rate 8 of new operating company listings. The quarter’s strong performance contributed to a 74% year-to-date new listings win rate. Year-to-date through the third quarter, new operating company listings raised $144 billion in proceeds, reflecting 89% of total proceeds raised. • Nasdaq expanded its distribution of private markets data through a partnership with Juniper Square. The partnership embeds eVestment's private markets data directly into Juniper Square’s client workflows, strengthening Nasdaq's position as a trusted provider of institutional investment intelligence. eVestment also expanded its coverage of private funds to more than 95,000, a 19% increase from the end of 2025. • Nasdaq executed several strategic actions to advance the evolution of capital markets. Nasdaq formed Digital Liquidity Networks (DLN), a new organization within Nasdaq Market Services focused on advancing the company’s leadership in digital assets and market modernization. Within DLN, Nasdaq completed the acquisition of LeveL Markets, the third- largest Alternative Trading System (ATS) in the U.S. by trading volume with more than 2,500 buy-side and sell-side clients. The acquisition, which closed early in the fourth quarter, enhances Nasdaq’s ability to serve a wider liquidity pool across off-exchange venues and deliver institutional-grade liquidity and execution solutions to clients. • Market Service s set a new record in third quarter net revenue and continued to lead the evolution of markets including the transition to Always-On markets. Third quarter Market Services net revenue benefitted from higher industry volumes across U.S. options and European equities with robust performance in U.S. cash equities, which achieved higher market share and near record capture. The Nasdaq Stock Market remains on track to go live with 23/5 trading on December 6, 2026, expanding global access to U.S.-listed equities. 5 ____________ 1 Represents revenue less transaction-based expenses. 2 Organic change is generally calculated by removing the impacts of changes in foreign exchange rates, and acquisitions and divestitures during the one-year period post transaction. Adjusted and organic change for 3Q26 as compared to 3Q25 are equivalent as they include the same period over period adjustments . 3 Solutions revenue constitutes revenue from our Capital Access Platforms and Financial Technology segments a s well as certain Other revenues. These Other revenues of $2 million and $4 million in 3Q26 and 3Q25, respectively, relates to the sale of our Nasdaq Fund Secondaries business and the sale of the Nasdaq Metrio platform and related customer contracts , which were both sold in 3Q26. Other revenues in 3Q25 also included $8 million related to the sale of the Solovis business, which was sold in 4Q25. These revenues were previously included in our Capital Access Platforms Segment. reference.summary: Nasdaq, Inc. operates as a technology company that serves capital markets and other industries in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology, and Market Services. The company distributes historical and real-time market data; develops and licenses Nasdaq-branded indices and financial products; provides investor relations intelligence, governance solutions, and sustainability solution products for public and private companies, and organizations, as well as insights and workflow solutions; and operates listing platforms.
